elements.name: Investigator
elements.desc:
You relentlessly seek the truth, and you have a knack for uncovering secrets. Perhaps you were a detective, a journalist, or a private eye. You might have been drawn to the supernatural, or you might have been hired to investigate a haunting. Whatever your past, you are now an adventurer, using your skills to uncover the hidden truths of the multiverse.

Skill Proficiencies: Choose two from Insight, Investigation, or Perception.
Tool Proficiencies: Disguise kit, Thieves' tools.
Languages: One of your choice.
Equipment: A set of common clothes, a disguise kit, a magnifying glass, a notebook, a pen, a pouch containing 10 gp, and a trinket of your choice.

traits: I am always calm, no matter what the situation. I never raise my voice or let my emotions control me.
I am a relentless seeker of truth, and I will not rest until I have uncovered it.
I am deeply suspicious of everyone I meet, and I am always looking for hidden motives.
I am fascinated by the supernatural, and I will go to great lengths to investigate it.
I am a stickler for details, and I notice things that others miss.
I am a loner, and I prefer to work alone.
I have a dry sense of humor, and I often use it to defuse tense situations.
I am haunted by a past case that I was unable to solve.
ideals: Truth. The truth must be uncovered, no matter the cost. (Lawful)
Justice. The guilty must be punished, and the innocent must be protected. (Good)
Knowledge. The pursuit of knowledge is the highest calling. (Neutral)
Power. Information is power, and I intend to have it all. (Evil)
Freedom. The truth will set you free. (Chaotic)
Balance. The truth lies somewhere in the middle. (Neutral)
bonds: I am searching for the truth about a missing person, and I will not stop until I find them.
I am trying to clear my name of a crime I did not commit.
I owe a debt to the person who taught me everything I know.
I am determined to uncover the secrets of a mysterious organization.
I am protecting someone who is in danger because of what they know.
I am trying to solve a case that has haunted me for years.
flaws: I am too suspicious for my own good, and I often alienate my allies.
I am obsessed with a particular case, and I will neglect everything else to solve it.
I am arrogant, and I believe I am the only one who can solve the mystery.
I am easily distracted by new information, and I often lose focus.
I am a compulsive liar, and I sometimes lie even when it would be better to tell the truth.
I am terrified of the supernatural, and I often freeze up when confronted with it.
